content.what_it_is: Static-figure counterpart of movie_eta_foam.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case (Case_15deg_longrun): builds a 3x2 panel figure for three selected snapshots files=[1 20 57] (L30) instead of a movie. Per snapshot (L40-L127) it reads binary single-precision eta_, mask_, age_ fields with dims [m n]=[660 800] and reorients each by transpose+flipud+fliplr (L47-L70), fabricates visualization fields exactly as the movie script: breaker = age clipped at 10 s (L77-L78), bubble = 1.5*exp(-breaker/10) with zero-sentinel 9000 and NaN floor 0.1 (L80-L83), foam = 1.0*exp(-age/50) after zeroing age>600 and masking dry cells (L86-L90), and NaNs eta on dry/breaking cells (L93-L94). Left column panels (subplot(3,2,(k-1)*2+1)) show rotated frf_03.jpg + pcolor(eta) + pcolor(bubble) with caxis [-1 3.5], colorbar and title 'surface elevation, t = <numb*600/3600> hr' (L96-L112); right column panels show foam with caxis [0 2] titled 'breaking signature' (L114-L125). After the loop it prints plots_movies/frame6_breaking.jpg and .eps (L129-L130). dep.out is read and reoriented (L12-L18) but not plotted.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
DimsX — cell holding fread dimensions [m n] (L9)
fname — current binary file name (L12, L47, L56, L64)
fileID — file handle (L13, L48, L57, L65)
dep — depth field, reoriented, unused in plots (L14-L18)
x — x coordinates registered to image (L25)
y — y coordinates registered to image, reversed (L26)
eta — surface elevation, reoriented and masked (L49-L54, L93-L94)

unresolved: The 600.0 s per snapshot assumed in the time label (L110) must match the case output interval, which is not in this file.

Synthetic bubble/foam parameters (thresholds 10 s and 600 s, decay scales 10 and 50, amplitudes 1.5 and 1.0, NaN floor 0.1, sentinel 9000.0; L77-L90) are visualization inventions per comment L74, with no physical basis stated.
dep is read (L12-L18) but never used.
Output file name frame6_breaking (L129-L130) does not obviously correspond to the three snapshots [1 20 57]; the naming rationale is not stated.
The exact model definition of the 'age' output field is not in this file.
